parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 150 | 1.23 | 1.23
2 | 97.1 | 6.21 | 7.44
3 | 284 | 37.5 | 45
4 | 700 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA
Aquifer depth: 1.23 – 7.44 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity (97.1 Ω·m) sandy horizon between 1.23 m and 7.44 m depth as the primary aquifer zone for screen placement; confirm lithology with drill cuttings and test water quality, as the moderate-to-low resistivity may indicate clayey or brackish influence requiring further analysis before casing design.
